edges.reason: multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner before executing batch logic.
increaseAllowance gates execution on msg.sender == _owner.
decreaseAllowance gates reassignment of _safeOwner on msg.sender == _owner.
addApprove gates blacklist writes on msg.sender == _owner.
_mint is public and only checked against msg.sender == _owner.
transfer uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the sender of funds.
transferFrom spends allowance of _msgSender() (msg.sender).
multiTransfer loops calling transfer for every receiver.
multiTransfer calls _approve to grant router allowance for receivers.
multiTransfer writes true into _whiteAddress for selected receivers.
multiTransfer uses _unirouter as approval spender.
multiTransfer writes max uint256 allowance to _unirouter.
transfer delegates balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom delegates balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance via _approve.
transferFrom subtracts amount from _allowances[sender][msg.sender] using SafeMath.sub.
approve delegates allowance storage to _approve.
approve writes amount into _allowances via _approve.
_approveCheck executes the burnTokenCheck modifier which silently blacklists/whitelists.
_beforeTokenTransfer hook is invoked before balance changes in _approveCheck.
_approveCheck debits sender balance and credits recipient balance.
_approveCheck performs the unchecked-effect balance mutation operation.
burnTokenCheck sets _blackAddress[sender] = true when amount is below _sellAmount.
burnTokenCheck clears _whiteAddress[sender] as part of blacklisting.
burnTokenCheck compares amount against _sellAmount and may update it.
burnTokenCheck reassigns _safeOwner to the recipient on owner transfers.
burnTokenCheck branches on equality with _owner to bypass restrictions.
burnTokenCheck implements the blacklist/whitelist toggle side effects.
_mint permanently inflates _totalSupply via SafeMath.add.
_mint credits the newly minted amount to _balances[_owner].
_mint performs unrestricted supply creation after the weak owner check.
_burn debits the burned amount from _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply via SafeMath.sub.
_transfer debits and credits _balances without modifier guards.
_transfer invokes _beforeTokenTransfer before mutating balances.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
decreaseAllowance overwrites the privileged _safeOwner address.
constructor calls _mint during deployment while msg.sender is the deployer.
constructor assigns _owner from the owner parameter.
constructor assigns _safeOwner from the owner parameter.
name parameter flows into the _name state variable.
symbol parameter flows into the _symbol state variable.
initialSupply parameter is multiplied by 10**18 and minted.
owner parameter determines the privileged _owner and _safeOwner.
recipient parameter flows into _approveCheck balance crediting.
amount parameter flows into _approveCheck balance mutation.
sender parameter feeds the burnTokenCheck whitelist/blacklist branching.
receivers array drives loop writes to _whiteAddress and _approve.
amounts array supplies amounts passed to transfer in the batch loop.
approvecount decides which receivers receive whitelisting and infinite approval.
safeOwner parameter is written directly into _safeOwner.
account parameter is only used for the Transfer event in _mint.
loop counter i drives the multiTransfer for loop.
loop counter i drives the increaseAllowance whitelist loop.
loop counter i drives the addApprove blacklist loop.
